The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 failures.

The `users` table is created by `migrations/001_create_users.js` with a column called `fullname`. `src/api/users.js` was reading and writing `full_name`, so the insert failed with "unknown column users.full_name". I changed `src/api/users.js` to use `fullname`, and I left `migrations/` alone as you asked.

The public `fullName` field in the API response is unchanged.
